tagline: A big clock with today's weather and a three-day outlook
description: A clock that updates on the device every minute (no network) above the current conditions and a three-day forecast from Open-Meteo, fetched and cached by a Cloudflare Worker. Set your place name, coordinates and units on the device's settings page.

changelog.notes: First release: device-side clock, current conditions, 3-day forecast, metric/imperial, landscape layout.
